scorecard_items.behavior: Stable JSON mode emits the relia.command_result envelope.
Non-interactive stdout is machine-readable by default.
Quiet and compact modes preserve status, evidence refs, typed exits, and machine-readable fields.
Machine-readable errors use stable typed exits.
Stable exit-code examples exist for codes 0 through 9.
Local operating-pack validation runs offline with a sandbox-writable Go build cache.

notes: Product commands beyond status/version/help are recognized as typed stubs in this foundation slice and return not_implemented until later task packets implement their behavior.
